finding.name: STALE_AUTH_CONTEXT_AFTER_CREDENTIAL_EXPIRY
finding.before: authenticate() rejected expired credentials, but the first rescue version of admit_request() revalidated credential/principal status and scope without rechecking expires_at or the captured principal auth epoch.
finding.risk: An AuthContext created before expiry could have been reused for a later request attempt after the credential expired, despite fresh authenticate() correctly rejecting the token.
finding.scope: candidate-only defect; canonical V16 migration/runtime was not changed by this candidate

invariants_added: Every request admission/replay attempt revalidates credential status.
Every request admission/replay attempt revalidates principal status.
Every request admission/replay attempt compares current principal auth_epoch with the AuthContext epoch.
Every request admission/replay attempt revalidates credential expires_at against the current attempt time.
Current scopes are checked before replay disclosure or consequential admission.
repair.new_regression: Create AuthContext before credential expiry, then attempt admission after expiry; must fail with STALE_OR_EXPIRED_AUTH_CONTEXT.

target_status.reason: No PASS-only target receipt is visible and GitHub Actions workflow discovery/execution remains inconsistent for the diagnostic branch.
